title: Define widget preset save security contract
description: Design the capability, nonce, transport, payload, normalization, and error contract for saving a preset from the Elementor widget.
objective: Make the widget-side save path safe and testable before implementation touches editor JS, REST/AJAX handlers, or persistence code.
inputs_required: Elementor editor nonce/capability patterns from local source
acceptance_criteria: The save path has an explicit capability requirement.
The save path has an explicit nonce requirement.
The payload contract rejects unknown or malformed filter rows safely.
The response includes saved preset identity and enough metadata for editor state updates.
The task does not implement the endpoint yet.
verification: Security contract references exact files or APIs inspected.
No plugin source changes are made.
risks: Using an editor-only action without a durable nonce source can create an untestable save path.
Overbuilding a custom editor control can accidentally become a second builder.
